files.role: transcription B (sheets Entries with stable IDs/Examples/Raw OCR Entries/Abbreviations/About)

source: Svelmoe, Gordon & Thelma Svelmoe (1990), Mansaka Dictionary (OCR transcriptions supplied by the researcher 2026-09-30)

Mansaka_Dictionary_Svelmoe_1990.xlsx: Sheet 'Entries': one row per headword sense. Sense numbers follow the dictionary's numbered subsenses or a change of part of speech within the entry (e.g. n. then v.).
Sheet 'Examples': one row per illustrative sentence pair (Mansaka sentence + English gloss).
Sheet 'English-Mansaka Finder': the reverse finder list from the back of the dictionary.
'Dictionary page' is the page number printed in the book; 'PDF page' is the page in the PDF file.

Caveats: the source is a scan with no text layer, so all text is OCR output. Expect occasional misread letters (e.g. 'I' read as '|' or '1', accented vowels lost, italic 'n.' read as '7.' or 'a.'). Bold/italic distinctions were inferred from layout and language, so a few example sentences may be split or paired imperfectly. The 'Full entry text (OCR)' column preserves the raw entry for checking.
Mansaka_Dictionary_Svelmoe_1990_2.xlsx: Source | Svelmoe, Gordon & Thelma Svelmoe (1990). Mansaka Dictionary. Summer Institute of Linguistics (Language Data, Asian-Pacific Series).
Coverage | Dictionary proper, book pages 1–496. The English–Mansaka reverse index (p. 497ff) is not included, since it repeats the same entries.
Counts | 6011 entries; 6539 sense rows; 13186 example sentence pairs.

Method | The PDF is a page scan with no text layer, so every page was OCR-ed (Tesseract, 300 dpi, per column) and parsed automatically. Entries were detected from the hanging-indent layout; each example was sorted into Mansaka vs. English by vocabulary scoring.

Known limitations | OCR errors occur, especially in accented vowels (e.g. à, ò, ù often misread), subscript homonym numbers, and occasional letters (e.g. "n" read as "u", "I" read as "1" or "J"). A small share of entries may be merged or split, or have an example assigned to the wrong language column. The "Raw OCR Entries" sheet holds the complete text of each entry for checking against the book.
Homonym | Numbered automatically when consecutive entries share the same spelling.
Book Page | Printed page number in the dictionary (PDF page minus 14).
